ImageDescription.value: Hemkund Sahib (also spelled Hemkunt), formally known as Gurudwara Shri Hemkund Sahib Ji, is a Sikh place of worship and pilgrimage site in Chamoli district, Uttarakhand, India. It is devoted to Guru Gobind Singh (1666–1708), the tenth Sikh Guru, and finds mention in Dasam Granth

ImageDescription.value: Located at an elevation of 15,000 feet above sea level, Hemkund Sahib is one of the most revered Sikh pilgrimage sites. Surrounded by breathtaking views of the Himalayan peaks, the Gurudwara offers a peaceful and spiritual atmosphere. The location is enhanced by a pristine holy lake with crystal-clear waters, reflecting the snow-covered mountains around it. The surrounding landscape is a visual treat, featuring snow-capped peaks and vibrant alpine meadows, offering one of the most stunning settings for spiritual reflection.
